relation.note: Served as muḥtasib during Sultan Khushqadam's reign.

event.desc: Appointed to the office of al-ḥisba (market inspector) in Cairo during the reign of Sultan al-Ẓāhir Khushqadam.
event.note: During the reign of Sultan al-Ẓāhir Khushqadam (865–872 AH)

person.note: スードゥン・アル＝バルドバキー・アル＝ムアイヤディー。シャイフであり、十人長（アミール・アシャラ）の一人。アッ＝ザーヒル・フシュカダムの治世に市場監督官（ムフタスィブ）に任命された者の一人である。

Sūdūn al-Bardbakī al-Muʾayyadī. A shaykh and one of the commanders of ten (amīr ʿashara). He was among those who were appointed to the office of market inspector (ḥisba) during the reign of Sultan al-Ẓāhir Khushqadam.
